negative_findings.description: Tatra banka's press-release index at https://www.tatrabanka.sk/sk/blog/tlacove-spravy/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain server-side fetch, while individual article slugs on the same path are indexed and reachable via search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead. Requires a browser-like fetch (real UA, JS-capable client) or an RSS/sitemap route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tatra banka is one of the three systemic SK banks; losing its self-published leadership channel would leave a hole that only third-party wires could partially fill.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Slovak-language press centre was located on mbank.sk itself; the SK press function appears to live on the group subdomain sk.media.mbank.pl. Likewise no distinct SK press/'o nás – vedenie' subpath was confirmed for oberbank.sk within this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: mBank SK press room identified on a foreign-group host; Oberbank SK press/management subpath unresolved (only the site root confirmed).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Branch-form banks (pobočka zahraničnej banky) often have no SK-level governance page at all, so SK branch leadership must be inferred from group announcements plus the SK company register — a systematically weaker signal for the smaller players in the cell.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searches for Prima banka press releases on predstavenstvo/dozorná rada changes returned almost only annual-report PDFs and third-party portals, not a press-release index on primabanka.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: No press-release feed confirmed for Prima banka; the manazment-banky page plus annual reports plus orsr.sk are the practical channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For this actor, page-diffing and register-diffing must substitute for press monitoring, which changes the collection design and the achievable detection latency (months, not days).

negative_findings.description: Prima banka annual reports are served from /preview-file/<slug>-<numeric-id>.pdf paths where the numeric id appears to be a rotating internal document id.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hard-coded PDF URLs are likely to break between years.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector that pins these URLs will silently start failing; the link must be re-resolved from the site each cycle.

negative_findings.description: FinStat.sk, the most convenient aggregator of SK register + financial + headcount data, is a commercial service with paywalled tiers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with collection_allowed=false; usable as a manual entity-resolution pointer or under a paid API licence only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids building a pipeline on a source whose ToS would not survive review, when orsr.sk provides the same statutory facts for free.

coverage_gaps.description: Within the cell's named actor list, Oberbank Slovensko and mBank SK were resolved only to a site root / group press room; no SK-level management ('vedenie', 'o nás') page was confirmed for either.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the navigation of oberbank.sk and mbank.sk directly to locate 'o nás'/'kontakt pre médiá' subpaths; if none exists, fall back to the Austrian and Polish group newsrooms plus the SK branch entry in orsr.sk.

coverage_gaps.description: Careers/ATS pages were confirmed only for SLSP and VÚB. The equivalent 'kariéra / voľné pracovné miesta' hubs for Tatra banka, ČSOB SK, 365.bank, Prima banka, UniCredit SK, mBank SK, Oberbank SK and J&T Banka were not individually resolved in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated per-actor pass on 'kariéra', 'voľné pracovné miesta', 'pridaj sa k nám', 'pracovné ponuky' and identify the ATS vendor behind each (many SK banks front onto third-party ATS hosts such as topjobs.sk, which offer far more structured listings than the bank page).

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom or sitemap.xml endpoints were identified for any of the newsrooms in this cell; every candidate is currently specified as an HTML crawl.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe /rss, /feed, /sitemap.xml and press-room platform feed conventions (especially for sk.media.mbank.pl, which runs on a purpose-built press-room product) to convert polling into cheap feed subscription.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill a baseline from the Wayback Machine for each 'vedenie/manažment banky' URL and from the last three years of annual-report governance chapters, so the first diffs are meaningful rather than noise.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide explicitly whether non-systemic SK banks are in scope; if so, add szrb.sk/vedenie-banky and Privatbanka's press channel to the cell.

coverage_gaps.description: UniCredit's CZ&SK press centre was reached only through its /en/ path with Czech-derived URL segments (tiskove-centrum/tiskove-zpravy); the Slovak-language variant was not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the sk/cs language variants of the UniCredit press index and determine whether SK-branch-specific items are published only in the local-language edition.

brief: The Slovak systemic banks are privately held and therefore self-publish their leadership and org-structure news first, in Slovak, through two distinct surfaces: a dated press feed (slsp.sk/sk/aktuality, vub.sk tlacove-centrum, csob.sk tlacove-spravy, tatrabanka.sk/sk/blog/tlacove-spravy, jtbanka.sk, 365.bank/pre-media, sk.media.mbank.pl) and a slow-moving management roster page ('vedenie banky' / 'manažment banky'), the latter being the only channel that reveals portfolio reshuffles never announced as a release. Coverage quality is highly uneven across actors: SLSP, VÚB, ČSOB and J&T maintain rich, crawlable Slovak feeds, whereas Prima banka publishes essentially nothing beyond its management page and annual reports, and the foreign-branch entities (UniCredit CZ&SK, mBank, Oberbank) push their announcements up to group hosts in Czech, Polish or German. Two cross-cutting layers make the cell robust: orsr.sk gives dated statutory confirmation of every predstavenstvo and dozorná rada change, and the verbatim wires tlacovespravy.sme.sk and omediach.com mirror releases from banks whose own sites resist automated fetching — Tatra banka's press index returned a 403 and should be treated as bot-defended rather than dead. The main outstanding work is the jobs/hiring dimension, where only the SLSP and VÚB careers hubs were pinned down and the underlying ATS vendors remain unidentified.
